final_message:
The project is in `./app`, and `mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests test-compile` passes there. I didn't run the app or call a model, and I didn't write any tests.

- **Setup:** Quarkus 3.40.1 with `quarkus-rest-jackson`, `quarkus-langchain4j-ollama` and `quarkus-hibernate-validator`. The coordinates are `org.acme:brief-review`, base package `org.acme`. The generator picked Java 25 as the compiler release, and it built here.
- **Reviewers:** `TechnicalReviewer` and `BusinessReviewer` are two LangChain4j AI services. Each has its own system prompt and answers with Summary, Strengths, Risks and Recommendations.
- **Workflow:** `ReviewWorkflow` runs both reviewers at the same time on virtual threads. It then merges the two reviews into one markdown report.
- **Endpoint:** `POST /review` takes `{"brief": "..."}`. A blank brief is rejected by validation. The response has `brief`, `technicalReview`, `businessReview` and `report`.
- **Ollama config:** `application.properties` points at `http://localhost:11434` with model `llama3.2`, temperature 0.2 and a 120s timeout. Those are my defaults, so change the model id if you want a different one.

I generated the project with the Maven plugin rather than `quarkus_create`, because that tool auto-starts dev mode and I wanted to avoid starting anything.
